meta.description: Golden vectors of legacy Kyber (round-3) as produced by pykyber v1.0.5. This file is append-only: never regenerate or edit it to make a test pass. If current code disagrees with these bytes, the current code is wrong. The only supported generator is tests/vectors/generate.py, which reads solely from the pinned PyPI wheel and the v1.0.5 git tag, never from current code.

path_families.keypair: crypto_kem_keypair(pk, sk, rng, Some((d, z))) at tag v1.0.5; Python KyberK(seed=d||z) asserted equal
path_families.encapsulation: crypto_kem_enc(ct, ss, pk, rng, Some(r_seed)) at tag v1.0.5 (32-byte r seed); Python encapsulate is randomized and not golden
path_families.decapsulation: crypto_kem_dec(ss, ct, sk) at tag v1.0.5, recorded via the Python KyberK.decapsulate() wrapper and asserted equal to the Rust output
